name: zopt_eval_int_compare_op
description: zOpt::EvalIntCompareOp evaluates integer comparison operator strings including equality, ordering, inequality, tolerance equality, and unknown operators.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because each inlined strcmp check uses an sbb flag sequence that the current LLIL lifter does not fully model. The smoke covers all accepted operator strings, true and false paths, tolerance equality edge cases, and unknown-operator fallback.
